description: Proposes that an e-mail and a chat message may refer to each other: temporal proximity plus (by default required) shared normalized word n-grams. Shared text is reported as evidence, not as a probability.

criteria.proximity: gate: the minimum possible |chat - email| over both uncertainty intervals is <= max_lag_seconds (and ordering matches direction)
criteria.quote_overlap: gate when require_quote_overlap: at least min_shared_ngrams shared word n-grams after Unicode casefold, punctuation removal and whitespace collapse
